data.design_policy: Retain the full model with columns in this order: intercept, indicators for blocks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 (reference block 1), N,P,K,NP,NK,PK,NPK. N,P,K use their original numeric 0/1 factor levels, and products denote interactions. All 24 original plot rows belong in the design. Numerical rank uses max(shape)*float64_machine_epsilon*largest singular value. Do not remove columns to manufacture unique coefficients.

source_provenance.source: Official R datasets SVN source,revision90725 listing
source_provenance.license: R distribution GPL>=2; underlying observations cited by individual dataset documentation
source_provenance.claim_scope: Historical public observations only; no new scientific observations or causal/representativeness assumption
source_provenance.decoder: rdata0.11.2 RDA or bounded literal numeric c(...) parser,no R evaluation
source_provenance.observation_status: Original historical values; no changed or synthetic observation.
source_provenance.source_context: Official R documentation describes a six-block factorial example with the three-way interaction confounded with blocks, sourced to an Imperial College MSc exercise sheet. The archive is not independent evidence of a newly conducted or representative field study.

planned_contrasts.np_interaction_average_over_k: Within the same block, take the nitrogen–phosphate difference-in-differences in fitted mean yield separately at K=0 and K=1, then average those two interactions with equal weight. This is not the NP coefficient at the K=0 reference level alone.
planned_contrasts.three_way_interaction: The change in that nitrogen–phosphate difference-in-differences between K=1 and K=0 in the full model.

data.estimability_policy: A linear contrast is estimable when its value is unchanged by every coefficient perturbation that leaves all 24 fitted plot values unchanged. Equivalently its contrast vector annihilates the full design nullspace. Distinguish uniqueness of all coefficients from estimability of a particular treatment contrast.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
